visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark brown hair and side-swept bangs wears a cream-colored, thick-knit sweater while sitting in a brightly lit indoor living room. She speaks with animated facial expressions, including raised eyebrows and a wide smile, directly into the camera lens. Behind her, a soft gray upholstered couch and the base of a modern black floor lamp are visible against an off-white wall. (2) She holds up a single, rectangular slice of deep orange-colored mullet roe that is encased in a transparent and pink-accented plastic vacuum-sealed packet. Colorful, variety-show style graphic text bubbles with white and pink borders pop onto the screen around her face to emphasize her points about the food's substantial thickness and lack of oiliness. (3) The camera angle cuts to a top-down view of a wooden tabletop where a large navy blue gift box labeled 'OCEAN BITES' is displayed. Her hands reach into the frame to unbox a variety of individually wrapped mullet roe snacks in red, white, and blue packaging, scattering them across the wooden surface to show the abundance of the set. (4) The woman is shown in a close-up framing as she holds two separate roe packets vertically between her thumb and forefinger, rotating them slightly to demonstrate the consistent thickness of the cuts. She points at the products with her other hand while maintaining eye-level contact with the viewer and continuing her enthusiastic explanation. (5) A sequence shows her tearing open a packet, the plastic crinkling as she pulls out a piece of roe and takes a large bite. Her cheeks are full as she chews, and she closes her eyes briefly to signify enjoyment, then points back at the camera to affirm the product's quality while variety-style subtitles continue at the bottom. (6) She presents a specific 'Black Gold' variant of the mullet roe, which has a darker, more intense amber hue and a glossy, translucent surface visible through the clear vacuum film. She holds the packet close to the lens to highlight the premium texture and the 'carbon grilled' branding printed in bold red and black Chinese characters on the exterior. (7) The video transitions through several gift set options, including a blue box with multiple compartments for organized snacking and a red box containing two large, whole, uncooked mullet roe lobes. The lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the rich, warm tones of the seafood products and the clean design of the branded packaging. (8) In a final sequence, she holds up a variety of complementary items, such as red bags of 'PORK JERKY' featuring a whimsical white character and a small acrylic keychain designed to look like a miniature mullet roe. She then displays a sturdy red paper gift bag with the brand logo 'MR. HIHI' and a waving character, smiling broadly as she makes a final call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic young female voice begins the track with a bright, high-pitched vocal delivery, speaking in Traditional Chinese with rapid speed and very few pauses. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track featuring a driving 4/4 synthetic beat, bright synthesizer chords, and a polished, commercial production feel that stays at a moderate volume under the voice. (2) A sharp, high-frequency sound of plastic being torn acts as a transient SFX, signaling the start of the product demonstration. The speaker's arousal level increases as she expresses mock disbelief at the product's generosity, her voice exhibiting a playful, exaggerated tone with rising pitch contours at the end of several phrases. (3) The sound floor is populated by the rhythmic rustling of multiple small plastic packets being unboxed and moved onto a wooden surface, creating a percussive layer of incidental noise. The BGM maintains a consistent tempo and major-mode tonality, providing an optimistic and persuasive atmosphere that complements the enthusiastic vocal performance. (4) As the woman takes a bite of the food, the audio mix captures a subtle, muffled sound of chewing followed by a quick, bright 'pop' sound effect that accompanies a graphic text update on the screen. The narration continues seamlessly, with the speaker's articulation remaining clear and professional despite the rapid pace of the information delivery. (5) A mid-frequency 'ding' chime or bell sound effect is used to emphasize the introduction of the 'Black Gold' premium roe variant. The audio quality is clean and studio-like, with high signal-to-noise ratio, although it sounds like it was recorded via a high-quality smartphone microphone in a controlled indoor environment. (6) The final phase features a slight swell in the BGM volume as the speaker delivers her concluding call-to-action. Her voice remains dominant and assertive, ending with a cheerful, high-valence rising intonation that suggests excitement and urgency, while a final 'whoosh' transition SFX leads into the end of the clip.
